tools.name: analyze_directory
tools.description: Tree-view of directory with LOC, function/class counts, test markers. Respects .gitignore. Paginates with next_cursor. Default max_depth=3. Large dirs (1000+ files) auto-compact to summary; pass summary=false for per-file list. git_ref restricts to files changed since a branch/tag/commit. Empty directories return zero counts.

max_depth.description: Maximum directory traversal depth for overview mode only. Default: 3. Pass 0 for unlimited depth. Use 1-3 for large monorepos to manage output size. Ignored in other modes.

git_ref.description: Restrict analysis to files changed relative to this git ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA). Empty string or unset means no filtering.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor field. Pass unchanged to retrieve the next page. Omit on the first call.

page_size.description: Files per page for pagination (default: 100). Reduce below 100 to limit response size; increase above 100 to reduce round trips.

summary.description: true = compact summary (totals plus directory tree, no per-file function lists); false = full output; unset = auto-summarize when output exceeds 50K chars. Mutually exclusive with cursor; passing both returns INVALID_PARAMS.

tools.name: analyze_file
tools.description: Functions, types, classes, and imports from a single source file. Fails if directory path supplied; use analyze_directory instead. Paginates with cursor/page_size; use fields=["functions","classes","imports"] to limit sections. git_ref not supported. Use analyze_module for a lightweight function/import index (~75% smaller). Supported: Astro, C/C++, C#, CSS, Fortran, Go, HTML, Java, JavaScript, JSON, Kotlin, Markdown, Python, Rust, TOML, TSX, TypeScript, YAML.

fields.description: Limit output to specific sections. Valid values: "functions", "classes", "imports", "all". The FILE header (path, line count, section counts) is always emitted regardless. Omitting this field returns all sections. Ignored when summary=true (summary takes precedence).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor field. Pass unchanged to retrieve the next page. Omit on the first call.

page_size.description: Files per page for pagination (default: 100). Reduce below 100 to limit response size; increase above 100 to reduce round trips.

summary.description: true = compact summary (totals plus directory tree, no per-file function lists); false = full output; unset = auto-summarize when output exceeds 50K chars. Mutually exclusive with cursor; passing both returns INVALID_PARAMS.
